title: Worshipped by Brahma and Vishnu
translation: The linga worshipped by Brahma, Vishnu and the gods, pure, shining and beautiful, which destroys the sorrow born of birth: I bow to that linga of Sadashiva.
translation_hi: जो लिंग ब्रह्मा, विष्णु और देवताओं द्वारा पूजित है, निर्मल, प्रकाशमान और सुशोभित है, और जन्म से उत्पन्न दुःखों का नाश करता है, उस सदाशिव लिंग को मैं प्रणाम करता हूँ।

words.note: Literally 'mark, sign'. In grammar, linga means gender!

grammar: A matra meter: each line has 16 matras in four beats of 4 (— ◡ ◡ or ◡ ◡ ◡ ◡). The scanner shows the Dodhaka pattern, and two light syllables may replace one heavy.
Retroflex n: प्र + नमामि → प्रणमामि. After र in the same word, न becomes ण.
Linga = sign: also the word for grammatical gender: पुंलिङ्ग, स्त्रीलिङ्ग, नपुंसकलिङ्ग.
